description: Extend the query sanitization functionality to properly handle join queries, specifically ensuring that virtual relationship field path transformations work correctly in joined collections. This will fix issues where certain query conditions fail when accessing related data through joins.
functional_requirements: Apply the existing `sanitizeWhereQuery` function to join query results to ensure consistent field path transformation
Ensure virtual relationship fields are properly transformed when accessed through joined collections
Maintain backward compatibility with existing query patterns while fixing the specific join query issue
Add appropriate test coverage to verify join query sanitization works correctly for various relationship scenarios
